2.289 0 0 0-1.665-1.665Z"></path></svg></a></span>的波长大于或至少等于原来入射光的波长。</p><p data-pid="16JdUeDA">反斯托克斯光：荧光光谱的波长小于原来入射光的波长。</p><hr><p data-pid="9wTvQmKZ"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="^{2S+1}L_{u/g}"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">^{2S+1}L_{u/g}</span></span></span> ，L依其取值0、1、2、3、4 写为Σ、Π、Δ、Φ、Γ... </p><p data-pid="CHamM23Q">第五章说是不咋考啊，那我看习题去了。</p><p data-pid="H7MFhtHC"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="B=\frac{\hbar}{4\pi I_e c}"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">B=\frac{\hbar}{4\pi I_e c}</span></span></span> ，-电离能+亲和能+库伦能（正）=结合能（正）</p><p data-pid="KYHWfdIn"><span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\nu^{\sim}=\nu_0^\sim+低态B'J'(J'+1)-高态B''J''(J''+1)"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\nu^{\sim}=\nu_0^\sim+低态B'J'(J'+1)-高态B''J''(J''+1)</span></span></span> </p><p data-pid="BFnO_mLG">R支： <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="J'=J''+1"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">J'=J''+1</span></span></span> ，P支： <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="J'=J''-1"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">J'=J''-1</span></span></span> </p><p data-pid="FQFJ0-2K">看 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\nu"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\nu</span></span></span> 对J导数什么时候为0，带入看 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\nu"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\nu</span></span></span> 是极大还是极小，极大说明带头在紫波，小说明在红波</p><p data-pid="F4NL7jPf">如果同时出现比入射光波长短和长的，看看三个光 <span class="ztext-math" data-eeimg="1" data-tex="\nu^\sim"><span></span><span><span class="tex2jax_ignore math-holder">\nu^\sim</span></span></span> 是不是等差，是就是得到等差值为分子经典振动频率/c，然后是一组拉曼散射。</p>
